# Lighter Finance

> Lighter Finance is an Australian business finance brokerage based in Sydney, NSW. We compare 60+ lenders to find unsecured business loans, equipment finance, working capital and more for Australian businesses, at no upfront cost to the client.

## What we do

- Search, compare and negotiate with 60+ lenders on behalf of Australian businesses
- Protect the client's credit score with a single soft enquiry before any application
- Specialise in 7 industries: hospitality, construction, retail, sole traders, professional services, plumbing and transport
- Finance products: unsecured business loans, secured loans, working capital, inventory finance, ATO tax debt funding, fit-out and renovation finance, equipment finance, vehicle finance, payroll funding, business loan refinancing and caravan loans
- Most applications turned around within the day
- $0 upfront broker fees: we are paid by the lender on settlement

## Key facts

- Location: Sydney, NSW, servicing clients Australia-wide
- Lender panel: 60+ lenders, including major banks, non-bank lenders, specialist financiers and equipment lenders
- Brokers: William (Director & Senior Broker), Steve, James, Toby
- Contact: enquiries@lighterfinance.com.au | 0478 022 067
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm AEST
